biggest_catch: Cashback is a rebate on spending, not income or guaranteed earnings — and pending cashback typically sits for about 90 days (longer for some merchants) before it becomes payable, so this is slow money.
catches: Cashback is a rebate on spending, not income or guaranteed earnings — rates and merchants change.
Pending cashback generally takes about 90 days to become payable and can take longer depending on the merchant.
You must complete the purchase in the same click-through session — abandoning the cart or leaving the site breaks tracking.
Returns or cancellations reverse the rewards.
The official terms mention inactive-account maintenance charges, but the exact trigger and amount could not be confirmed from the accessible official text — re-check the live terms.
$10 minimum balance to withdraw; check or PayPal only.

Choose your retailer on MaxRebates and click through to the store.
Complete your purchase in the same click session without leaving the site.
Check your account to confirm the reward shows as pending.
Wait for the pending period — generally about 90 days, longer for some merchants.
Once your balance reaches $10, request a payout via check or PayPal.
